lines.beaver: 민호야, 고등학교 때 추억 떠올려 본 적 있어?
lines.beaver_en: Minho, have you ever thought back on high school memories?
lines.beaver_roman: Minhoya, godeunghakgyo ttae chueok tteoollyeo bon jeok isseo?
lines.learner: 응, 요즘 그때 일이 자꾸 떠올라.
lines.en: Yeah, those days keep coming back to me lately.
lines.roman: Eung, yojeum geuttae iri jakku tteoolla.

lines.beaver_en: Those were good times. Is it hard now?
lines.learner: 솔직히 좀. 요즘 부담이 너무 커.
lines.en: Honestly, a bit. The pressure is too much lately.
lines.roman: Soljiki jom. Yojeum budami neomu keo.

lines.learner: 응, 주변 기대가 커서 마음이 늘 무거워.
lines.en: Yeah, people expect a lot, so my heart always feels heavy.
lines.roman: Eung, jubyeon gidaega keoseo maeumi neul mugeowo.

lines.beaver: 그런 속마음은 처음 듣네. 말해 줘서 고마워.
lines.beaver_en: I've never heard you share this. Thanks for telling me.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureon songmaeumeun cheoeum deunne. Malhae jwoseo gomawo.
lines.en: Actually, I hesitated a long time about telling you.

lines.beaver_en: Why? You can talk to me freely.
lines.en: I was worried whether you'd understand how I feel.

lines.beaver_en: Of course I understand. You must have suffered alone.
lines.en: Yeah, sometimes I'm so lonely it's really hard.

lines.learner: 미술을 그만둔 게 후회스러워. 아직 미련이 있어.
lines.en: I regret quitting art. I still can't let it go.
lines.roman: Misureul geumandun ge huhoeseureowo. Ajik miryeoni isseo.

lines.beaver: 그랬구나. 너 그림 그릴 때 정말 행복해 보였어.
lines.beaver_en: I see. You looked so happy when you drew.
lines.beaver_roman: Geuraetguna. Neo geurim geuril ttae jeongmal haengbokae boyeosseo.
lines.learner: 근데 아직도 그 꿈을 못 잊었어.
lines.en: But I still haven't forgotten that dream.
lines.roman: Geunde ajikdo geu kkumeul mon nijeosseo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 다시 시작해 보는 건 어때?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom dasi sijakae boneun geon eottae?
lines.learner: 마음은 간절한데, 실패할 것 같은 예감이 들어.
lines.en: I really want to, but I have a feeling I'll fail.
lines.roman: Maeumeun ganjeolhande, silpaehal geot gateun yegami deureo.

lines.beaver: 걱정되면 나한테 말해. 난 늘 네 편이잖아.
lines.beaver_en: If you're worried, tell me. I'm always on your side.
lines.beaver_roman: Geokjeongdoemyeon nahante malhae. Nan neul ne pyeonijana.
lines.en: Thanks. Thanks to you, I feel much lighter.
